home.name: Ariel Hukporti
home.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

home.name: Joel Embiid
home.comment: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

away.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
away.comment: Antetokounmpo (groin) has been upgraded to probable for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.

home.name: Sion James
home.comment: James is probable for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to general soreness.

home.name: Grayson Allen
home.comment: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.

home.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
home.comment: Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.

home.name: Kon Knueppel
home.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

home.name: Dennis Schroder
home.comment: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

away.name: Jalen Smith
away.comment: Smith (illness) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.

away.name: Norman Powell
away.comment: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

away.name: Caleb Wilson
away.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: Evan Mobley
away.comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

away.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
away.comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

home.name: Chet Holmgren
home.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

home.name: Aday Mara
home.comment: Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.

home.name: Thomas Sorber
home.comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

home.name: Nikola Topic
home.comment: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.

home.name: Cason Wallace
home.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

home.name: Jalen Williams
home.comment: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

home.name: Jaylin Williams
home.comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

away.name: Jaylen Clark
away.comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

away.name: Donte DiVincenzo
away.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

away.name: Anthony Edwards
away.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

away.name: Nolan Traore
away.comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

home.name: Cameron Boozer
home.comment: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

home.name: Jerami Grant
home.comment: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

home.name: GG Jackson
home.comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

away.name: Bradley Beal
away.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

away.name: Jordan Miller
away.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

away.name: Mark Williams
away.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: Ben Simmons
away.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

away.name: Maxime Raynaud
away.comment: Raynaud (knee) was assigned to the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

home.name: Vit Krejci
home.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

home.name: Ja Morant
home.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

home.name: Shaedon Sharpe
home.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

home.name: Chris Youngblood
home.comment: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.
